description_zh: 查看支持恢复的库表信息详情
name: DescribeMetaList

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters in your account
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查询账号下所有集群的信息详情
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set.

You must specify either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98102.html operation to query the backup set ID
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。
查询时，`BackupId`和`RestoreTime`参数必选其一传入。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98102.html接口查看备份集ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98102.html operation to query the point in time for restoration
parameters.help_zh:
还原时间点，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ（UTC时间）。
查询时，`BackupId`和`RestoreTime`参数必选其一传入。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98102.html接口查看还原时间点
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database, such as `test_db`. If you specify this parameter, the names of all tables that can be recovered from the specified database are returned.

You can specify only one database name at a time.

If you do not specify this parameter, the names of all databases that can be recovered from the current backup set are returned. The names of tables in each database are not returned
parameters.help_zh:
传入具体的数据库名称（如`test_db`）以获取目标数据库所有支持恢复的数据表名称。
每次仅支持传入一个数据库名称。
若该参数留空，您可以查看当前备份集下所有支持恢复的数据库名称，但无法查看各数据库下对应的数据表名称
parameters.name: get_db_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100 Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：
30
50
100
默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319132.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319132.html查询
parameters.name: region_code

Items.description_en: The details of recoverable databases and tables
Items.description_zh: 支持恢复的库表信息详情

Database.description_en: The name of the database that can be recovered
Database.description_zh: 支持恢复的数据库名称

Size.description_en: The size of the database or table, in bytes

items.description_en: The size of the database or table in bytes

Tables.description_en: The names of the tables that can be recovered

items.description_en: The name of the recoverable table

PageSize.description_en: The number of records on the current page
